D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.StrongSubadditivity.entropy_relabelState
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.signature: @[simp] theorem entropy_relabelState (e : m ≃ n) (rho : DensityState n) : vonNeumannEntropy (relabelState e rho) = vonNeumannEntropy rho

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.StrongSubadditivity.entropy_toMState
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.signature: theorem entropy_toMState (rho : DensityState n) : Sᵥₙ (toMState rho) = vonNeumannEntropy rho

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.StrongSubadditivity.strong_subadditivity
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/StrongSubaddit.signature: theorem strong_subadditivity {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (rho : DensityState (A × (B × C))) : vonNeumannEntropy rho + vonNeumannEntropy (marginalRight (marginalLeft rho)) ≤ vonNeumannEntropy (marginalRight (relabelState (Equiv.prodAssoc A B C) rho)) + vonNeumannEntropy (marginalLeft rho)
